details:
<Steps to reproduce>

1. Join to a Group+ instance and receive an instance full error once

2. register to the Group+ instance Join queue.

3. wait your turn in the queue.

4. Receive notification that it is your turn in the queue.

5. receive notification that entry is not possible due to instance full

The queue system keeps old historical information and returns past incorrect errors when it is the queue's turn.

The following is the log at that time:

------------

2024.02.12 00:22:36 Log        -  AnswerNotification for notification:<Notification from username:, sender user id:8JoV9XEdpo to  of type: localNotifs, id: 51064722, created at: 02/11/2024 15:22:24 UTC, details: {{}}, type:localNotifs, m seen:True, message: "Your queue is ready!

Press "join" in the widget or in this notification to start travelling.">

title: Incorrect history is being maintained in the queue system of the Group+ instance
